messages:
Priya: Heads-up 40m ago healthscore pipeline started returning a cluster of +20 points for many accounts after enrichment run. Noticed spikes in 'at-risk' tags.
Omar: saw the alert. healthscore_drift > 15pt for 52 accounts in enterprise cohort. Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/healthscore-drift
Lina: any deploys or data changes around that time?
Priya: enrichment job ran a contact merge + 3rd-party enrichment at 2025-05-21T03:10Z. suspect profile completeness weighting changed.
Gabe: quick check: model version is v1.12 still, but feature transform config bumped `profile_completeness_weight` from 0.15 -> 0.6 during the enrichment pipeline PR. commit: `feat(enrich): amplify completeness weight for scoring`
analytics-bot: ALERT: HEALTHSCORE_DISTRIBUTION_SHIFT #3302468013 severity=medium; affected_metric=score_delta; sample_count=52
Omar: impact: 52 accounts moved into 'renewal-risk' playbook, 8 have renewals <45d. Could be noisy.
Lina: can we pause playbook triggers for risk_tag changes from automated healthscore for 1h while we investigate?
Priya: propose: 1) feature-flag rollback of profile weight to 0.15 2) run a simulated scoring job to compare deltas 3) backout playbook transitions for accounts where delta > 10 and renewal < 45d 4) notify AMs for affected renewals 5) add regression test and alert. Agree?
Gabe: I'll open the rollback PR for the transform config and promote canary in staging now.
analytics-bot: action logged: feature-flag toggle request by Gabe.
Omar: writing query to identify affected accounts: `select account_id, old_score, new_score, delta from healthscore_runs where run_ts >= '2025-05-21T03:00' and run_ts < '2025-05-21T04:00' and delta > 10`
Lina: also need to freeze outbound playbook transitions for 'renewal-risk' until we finish. Can we scoped-freeze by source=healthscore-auto?
Priya: yes, pausing automation now. ops-command: `playbook.freeze(source=healthscore-auto, duration=1h)`
analytics-bot: playbook.freeze acknowledged.
Gabe: canary rollback applied in staging, simulation shows 48/52 accounts return to previous band; 4 still drift due to enrichment additions (new ARR field).
Omar: exporting list of 8 with renewal <45d and delta >10 to /tmp/hs_drift_330246.csv. Will prepare owner pings.
Lina: for the 4 that still drift, we should inspect enrichment schema; maybe new ARR field incorrectly parsed as string causing scaling.
Gabe: PR merged to revert weight change and added a deploy-time validator to ensure profile_completeness_weight <= 0.25 in prod.
analytics-bot: rollback deploy started (canary + prod).
Priya: after rollback, run remediation plan: 1) revert playbook transitions for accounts where delta >10 and automated_source=true 2) notify AMs for 8 renewals and offer manual check-in 3) run postmortem.
Omar: remediation dry-run shows 52 transitions would be reverted; will proceed with live run in 20m.
Lina: owner DM template: "We observed a temporary healthscore calculation change that caused extra 'renewal-risk' flags for <account>. We've reverted the scoring config and will revert automated transitions. Please expect one fewer automation touch. Reply if you want us to pause outreach."
Gabe: remediation executed: reverted 52 transitions, 8 renewal accounts queued for manual reachout.
analytics-bot: remediation job complete: reverted=52, failures=0.
Priya: follow-ups: add CI test comparing scoring distribution on staging vs baseline for enrichment runs, add alert if >5% of cohort shifts >10 points, and include deploy-time guard for transform config. Assigning owners: Gabe=deploy guard + PR, Omar=remediation scripts + alert, Lina=owner comms + postmortem.
Lina: drafting postmortem and will post to #customer-success-postmortems with timeline and outreach logs.
Priya: nice work team. Recommendation: treat enrichment changes as safety-critical with a mandatory canary window and preflight simulation against a production snapshot.
Gabe: agree. Adding preflight job to enrichment pipeline.
Omar: closing loop: AMs acknowledged, no customer escalations so far. :white_check_mark:
